components.gap: Display the selected typed higher-order language together with its own comprehension/choice rule or schema system. Define the Henkin/general models corresponding to a displayed typed higher-order calculus and prove its soundness plus completeness through the exact first-order encoding and decoding, including nonempty sorts and extensionality where required. On route this is done only for the relational translation-defined calculus (def:p02-sol-matched-henkin, thm:p02-sol-derived-adequacy, annex:p2.hol.7, annex:p2.hol.8); for typed HOL the Henkin type structure is defined (inherited-12784-12923.tex lines 19-32) but completeness appears only as a 'Cited theorem' to Henkin1950 (lines 58-67), not proved.
